name: Mixed Relief
description: Combination of raised and recessed forms. Used in surrealism or complex scenes with dynamic depth cues.
carving_traits: Challenging to compose well in grayscale
Can produce striking visuals if carefully composed
machinability_prompt: Generate a grayscale heightmap combining raised and recessed features. Lighter tones raise out of the surface, darker tones recess. Ensure depth transitions are clear. Avoid shadows and ambient textures.
